title: Forever
lyrics_original: The moon and stars they wept
The Saviour of the world was fallen
His blood poured out for us
The weight of every curse upon him
The son of God was laid in darkness
The war on death was waged
The power of hell forever broken
His perfect love could not be overcome
Now death where is your sting?
He is alive, He is alive!
His perfect love could not be overcome
Now death where is your sting?
He is alive, He is alive!
He is alive, He is alive!
author_english: Brian Johnson, Kari Jobe, Jenn Johnson, Gabriel Wilson, Joel Taylor, Christa Black Gifford

bible_verses.telugu: మధ్యాహ్నము మొదలుకొని మూడు గంటలవరకు ఆ దేశమంతటను చీకటికమ్మెను. ఇంచుమించు  మూడు గంటలప్పుడు యేసుఏలీ, ఏలీ, లామా సబక్తానీ అని బిగ్గరగా కేకవేసెను. ఆ మాటకు నా దేవా, నా దేవా నన్నెందుకు చెయ్యి విడిచితివని అర్థము.
bible_verses.english: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land. About three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, 'Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?' (which means 'My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?').

bible_verses.telugu: ఆత్మను గూర్చిన వాగ్దానము విశ్వాసమువలన మనకు లభించునట్లు, అబ్రాహాము పొందిన ఆశీర్వచనము క్రీస్తుయేసుద్వారా అన్యజనులకు కలుగుటకై, క్రీస్తు మనకోసము శాపమై మనలను ధర్మశాస్త్రముయొక్క శాపమునుండి విమో చించెను;
bible_verses.english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, for it is written: 'Cursed is everyone who is hung on a pole.'

bible_verses.telugu: మనము పాపముల విషయమై చనిపోయి, నీతివిషయమై జీవించునట్లు, ఆయన తానే తన శరీరమందు మన పాపములను మ్రానుమీద మోసి కొనెను. ఆయన పొందిన గాయములచేత మీరు స్వస్థత నొందితిరి.
bible_verses.english: 'He himself bore our sins' in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; 'by his wounds you have been healed.'

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for bearing the unbearable weight of my sin upon the cross. You entered the deepest darkness so that I could walk in Your glorious light. I am humbled by Your sacrifice and filled with gratitude for the victory You won in the grave. Teach me to live each day in the freedom and hope of Your unfailing love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for bearing the unbearable weight of my sin upon the cross. You entered the deepest darkness so that I could walk in Your glorious light. I am humbled by Your sacrifice and filled with gratitude for the victory You won in the grave. Teach me to live each day in the freedom and hope of Your unfailing love. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When Jesus hung on the cross, creation itself felt the weight of His sacrifice as darkness covered the earth. He willingly bore the full curse of our sin and entered the depths of the grave to defeat death once and for all. As we sing this song, we are invited to pause in awe of the immense cost of our redemption. Let your heart rest in the quiet assurance that the darkest moment in history was actually the beginning of our eternal freedom.
